name: File Browser
description: Browse, upload and share files from any browser.
notes: It shows /srv (change the folder in /opt/filebrowser/docker-compose.yml). First login: admin / admin — change it right away.
compose:
services:
  filebrowser:
    image: filebrowser/filebrowser:latest
    container_name: filebrowser
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:80"
    volumes:
      - /srv:/srv
      - {DATA}/database:/database
      - {DATA}/config:/config
